chunks: And Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān narrated from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The divorce of a free woman, when she is married to a slave, is three divorces; and the divorce of a bondwoman, when she is married to a free man, is two divorces.

key_terms.الْحُرَّةِ: a free woman, as opposed to a bondwoman
key_terms.تَطْلِيقَاتٍ: instances or counts of divorce pronouncement
key_terms.طَلَاقُ: divorce; the legal dissolution of marriage

ai.seo_question: How many divorces apply when a free woman is married to a slave or a bondwoman is married to a free man?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the number of divorces recognized in marriages involving differing legal statuses of freedom and bondage. It states that a free woman married to a slave is divorced by three divorces, while a bondwoman married to a free man is divorced by two divorces.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4864 - Ḥammad ibn ʿUthman narrated from Al-Ḥalabi, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"The divorce of a free woman when she is married to a slave is three divorces, and the divorce of a bondwoman when she is married to a free man is two divorces."
